Specification: This specification models a trivial one-variable transition system with a single state variable x. The initial state requires x = 0, and the next-state action sets x' = 1, while the behavior specification is given by Init /\ [][Next]_x. It also defines a simple temporal property Prop using eventual-always TRUE implying TRUE; there is no fault model, no fairness condition, and no proof content.
